correctness.rationale: Proof identifies all length-N factors via level-k complementary block cuts and the classical factor count 3N−2, proves cyclic 00/11 counts H_k=(2^k+2(−1)^k)/6, obtains mixed-word 00/11 counts by telescoping, and exhaustively counts the eight signatures for both parities. A separate literal checker verified every signature and representation for k=2..10. An independent symbolic reduction verified all eight table entries as polynomial identities for the even and odd parity parameters. No infinite claim relies solely on computation.

value.rationale: The older eight-class complexity value hides the actual ambiguity of selecting one factor from its two-gram composition and endpoints. The exact eight individual class sizes exhibit a previously unquantified alternating pair of limiting normalized ambiguity spectra at canonical substitution scales, relevant to constrained factor reconstruction and symbolic dynamics. The answer is not implied by the known number of classes or total factor count, and the structural cut-count argument is more than an arbitrary finite computation.
